client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID of your Kwai Marketing API app.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: The Client Secret of your Kwai Marketing API app.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from Kwai's OAuth flow, used to generate new access tokens.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Deprecated for most accounts -- prefer Corp ID. 'Channel developer' app registrations are rejected outright when listing accounts by Agent ID ('The channel developer can not use agentId to query account list'), confirmed across two separate apps and several agent IDs. Only set this if Corp ID is unavailable and your app registration is known to permit it.

corp_id.title: Corp ID
corp_id.description: The Kwai Business Center corporation ID. NOTE: a Corp ID identifies the ADVERTISER, not your agency -- one corporation typically contains the accounts of several competing agencies serving that same advertiser. Listing by Corp ID returns all of them, including accounts you may have no entitlement to read. Use this only to discover and confirm which accounts are yours, then restrict the sync with Account IDs. Takes precedence over Agent ID when both are set.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: The earliest date to pull report data from, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: The latest date to pull report data from, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to sync up to today.

account_ids.title: Account IDs
account_ids.description: The advertiser account IDs to sync. Set this to the accounts your organization is actually entitled to read. When set, the report streams query exactly these accounts and never call the account-listing endpoint. Leaving it empty syncs EVERY account the Corp ID exposes, which in a shared-advertiser corporation means other agencies' accounts too -- only do that if you are certain the whole corporation is yours. Review the list against the 'advertisers' stream when accounts are added.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: The IANA-style time zone offset Kwai should report metrics in (e.g. UTC-3). Accepted values are limited by Kwai's API.

lookback_window_days.title: Lookback Window (days)
lookback_window_days.description: Number of days before the last synced date to re-fetch on every incremental run, to capture late conversion updates.

window_in_days.title: Window Size (days)
window_in_days.description: Maximum number of days requested in a single report call.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of records requested per page from the Kwai API.
